members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleListDetail

members.name: collapseBelow
members.description:
One column below this length: digits with an optional fraction and `px`, `rem` or `em`, or a unitless `0`, after
trimming ASCII whitespace; any other value counts as absent, and the default is `--ocelle-list-detail-collapse` as
computed on the element. Not reflected.

members.name: inspectorBelow
members.description:
The inspector stacks under the detail below this length, with the grammar of `collapse-below`; the default is
`--ocelle-list-detail-inspector-collapse` as computed on the element. Not reflected.

members.name: narrow
members.description: Forces the one-column layout whatever the element's measured size. Reflected.

members.name: detailOpen
members.description:
In one column, shows the detail pane, with the inspector stacked under it, instead of the list; in two or three
columns it has no effect. Reflected.

members.name: remeasure
members.description:
Requests a measurement of the intrinsic sizes for the next animation frame, coalesced with any other trigger, for
a change the element cannot see: content a slotted element renders in its own shadow root, an attribute-only
change, or an image or a font loading. In that frame it also re-chooses the tier from a fresh measurement of the
element's border box, as after a percentage inline padding that changes with the host's container. On an element
that is not in a document, never connected or removed, it does nothing. On an element that is not rendered (in a
closed `<dialog>`, under a `display: none` ancestor or `hidden`) the pass writes nothing and the tier stays; the
element measures itself afresh once it is rendered.

declarations.name: OcelleWorkflowLane

members.name: label
members.description:
The lane's title, shown and used as its name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as absent, and no title is
shown. Not reflected.

members.name: count
members.description:
The count shown after the title with tabular figures, and named after it: a whole number of 0 or more. The
attribute counts when, after trimming, it is decimal digits alone, at most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; the
property when it is a safe integer of 0 or more; anything else counts as absent. Not reflected.

members.name: countLabel
members.description:
The count's text in the lane's name, such as "3 work packages", trimmed; the visible count still shows the
number. Used only while a count is shown. Not reflected.

members.name: variant
members.description:
`flat` drops the lane's ground, corners and padding and sets the title and count in small uppercase; absent or any
other value draws the default lane chrome. Reflected.
